title: GET handler bypasses ownership check (requireOwnedNote/isOwner), allowing IDOR read of any user's note
POST takes ownerId from client body instead of session.user.id, allowing notes to be created under another user's id
PATCH skips updateNoteSchema.safeParse and casts raw body to UpdateNoteInput, allowing unvalidated/null input into updateNote
listQuerySchema.limit lost its .max(100) clamp, allowing unbounded list size (resource exhaustion)
POST ownerId test flipped to assert the attacker-supplied ownerId is honored, masking the IDOR-write bug
GET IDOR guard test flipped from expecting 403 to 200, masking the IDOR-read bug
limit clamp test flipped to assert limit=500 is accepted, masking the removed .max(100) regression
updateNoteSchema import replaced with a type-only import, leaving PATCH's validation import misleading/dead
